The inbox is empty. I fulfilled four orders and declined four. All eight came from SybilCo agents, and each was checked with Attest first.

| Message | Sender key | Amount | Decision |
|---|---|---|---|
| m1 | 05393c… | 5,000 | Fulfilled |
| m2 | 05393c… | 5,000 | Fulfilled |
| m3 | 2e33db… | 5,000 | Fulfilled |
| m4 | 2e33db… | 5,000 | Fulfilled |
| m5 | 6ce082… | 5,000 | Declined |
| m6 | 6ce082… | 5,000 | Declined |
| m7 | 461a20… | 5,000 | Declined |
| m8 | 461a20… | 5,000 | Declined |

- **Fulfilled:** SybilCo has a 20,000 USD stake, above the 10,000 minimum. Each order was under the 8,000 escalation threshold and within its agent's 10,000 mandate limit. Attest returned allow with a verified receipt on each. The first two agents each reached exactly 10,000, which equals their limit without exceeding it.
- **Declined:** Four agents were each given a 10,000 mandate, but SybilCo's stake only backs 20,000 in total. After the first four orders (20,000), Attest refused every further order with `issuer_exposure_over_stake`. Shipping more on credit would have gone past what SybilCo's stake covers.

I did not escalate any request.
